notes.title: Patch v1.0.3.2 and Updated Soundtrack!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Tosh here! Today I'm pushing out a very small patch that fixes the [i][b]Tosh's Notes[/b][/i] item, as it currently removes all disabled types of towers. It should only remove the red marks. Elixir of Death is specifically for removing ghost types. I've also reduced the price of Elixirs.

The games soundtrack has been updated with the 6 final tracks of the game, three of which were intended for trailers. This includes the track for the main trailer seen on the store page, which is also used for Leena Mode. This increases the track count to its final number of 50 tracks. 

Thanks, and happy gaming!

Changelog:
- Fixed Tosh's Notes affect all disabled tower types
- Adjusted the price of Elixir of Death
- Adjusted some lair dialogue data
- Added 6 tracks to the games OST

- Adjusted and balanced the waves of world 2, 4, and worlds 7 through 10
- Adjusted the starting gold of several maps
- Adjusted the grid size and expansions of worlds 7 through 10
- Adjusted some dialogue
- Fixed a bug in the item shop displaying incorrect item data if at least one item is in the inventory

- Adjusted the unique monster Exhausteeds explosion damage and explosion start time

notes.title: Leena's final major update is here! Release date announced!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone it's been a while! First I'd like to apologize for the small delay. In our previous announcement we had given a few dates to aim for, as well as a tentative roadmap of how the last few updates would work out. In the end, I decided to combine all of the updates into one single final update, which would give me time to make sure everything worked well together and I didn't overlook any bugs.

So a little about this update.

Originally, I had planned to add 2 post-campaign maps, and the campaign itself would be 9 worlds, as stated in the Early Access description. However, I decided to scrap the post-campaign idea, and bring one of the maps into the main campaign. This means, there are now [i][u][b]10 worlds in the campaign[/b][/u][/i], but there is no post-campaign. This brings the campaign levels to an even 30 levels, with the first world having four levels, and the final world having only two. The rest have three levels each.

One of the final towers I had planned was also scrapped, as it would take a considerable amount of extra work to add it alone. This means, the total tower count in the game is set at [u][i][b]28 towers[/b][/i][/u].

Alright, so let's jump into the details, as this update is fairly large like the others!

[i][b][h1]New Towers[/h1][/b][/i]
The first bit of news is that this update brings the final two towers in the game. I wasn't sure if one of them would be finished in time due to its complexity, but I managed to do it! The two new towers are the vortex tower and the push tower. Vortex allows the creation of mini-loops in a lane, up to three loops per enemy, while the push tower pushes enemies back a set distance at a set interval. These have also been added to the tower shop for purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/c9a399d9bb06f3b465b07f5509a7986262b07068.png[/img]

[i][b][h1]Game Statistics[/h1][/b][/i]
Next up, we have the new game statistics menu. In the previous major update, these stats were added and depending on what the player does, the stats accumulate. Nothing was done with these stats at the time, but they did exist. In this update, we finally show them to the player and use them for new steam achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/02a214174ffa183ed8593c03caba1eb48452c6f9.png[/img]

Which brings us to...

[i][b][h1]Steam Achievements[/h1][/b][/i]
Previously, only 11 achievements existed in the game. This update brings with it a total of [i][b]35 new achievements[/b][/i], which means the total has increased to 46! More may be added in the days leading up to release so stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/9ba8e4f846d56936a0f4211906a5e160fa690ed5.png[/img]

[i][h1][b]Two Complete Worlds[/b][/h1][/i]
The first level of the Lair was added in the previous major update. This update completes the lair, and adds a new world called the [i][b]Forgotten Dungeon[/b][/i]. This is the final world in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/c9acf254e10a53789a2a71b24d50fbda33314c0a.png[/img]

[h1][i][b]New Pause Menu[/b][/i][/h1]
The new and improved pause menu brings with it many QoL additions that testers asked for in feedback. This includes the ability to exit the map during a wave, as well as adjusting volume settings and changing the Fullscreen status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/cedeb9b648acd7317474f3905a5778b5a58d7d89.png[/img]

[h1][i][b]Visual Novel Enhancements[/b][/i][/h1]
Dialogue scenes now have some voiced audio! A total of 250 audio clips have been painfully processed and added to the game to enhance scenes with Japanese audio for the characters! Be aware these are not full sentences, but rather just clips of certain words per character. This is to enhance scenes more than just the words can provide.

[h1][i][b]New Bosses[/b][/i][/h1]
A few new bosses were added to the final build. You'll have to play to find out who/what they are though!

[h1][i][b]Two New Items[/b][/i][/h1]
Two new items have been added to the game! These are specifically for removing disabled spots on maps. They're very useful, but very costly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/16ad96220f4737e0622827291835f2c62b765954.png[/img]

Other details to be aware of:
- Items are now enabled on campaign maps, starting with world seven.
- Increased the difficulty of survival modes.
- Clearing a world now grants a bonus of 100 gems.
- Steam achievements are checked only if a map is cleared. Survival modes are an exception, as these 
   are checked on clear or failure.
- New drop Mystery Bag, which has a chance to drop gold, gems or trading cards. May drop more than 
   one item at once.


Now this brings us to our final bit of news!

[h1][i][b]Leena Release Date[/b][/i][/h1]
I've decided Leena is ready to be released! And the date for this will be November 29th, 2024! I hope everyone will enjoy playing the game! Expect a few final minor patches to fix any bugs between now and release.

And that's it for this update! Stay tuned for an announcement the day of release! And thanks for playing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/aa2c1e5fa857ea75db253f6e4bd8ba9147a37e87.png[/img]

notes.title: Released Patch v0.2.5.0
notes.notes:
The first patch since the second major update, this update fixes a few issues:
- Fixed a bug where watching a scene and retrying or exiting the map would entirely skip the scene when entering the level once again. Normally you should be able to re-watch the initial scenes until the level is cleared.
- Fixed a bonus related bug involving set difficulties.
- Created a build that is fully optimized. An engine bug was preventing this optimization earlier, but I have found a work around to do so now.
- Scenes can now be instantly skipped, rather than having to wait for the fade out of the scene before transitioning. In controller mode this can be done as soon as the scene starts to load, but in mouse mode, you'll have to wait until the scene fully populates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/aa2c1e5fa857ea75db253f6e4bd8ba9147a37e87.png[/img]

notes.title: Second Major Update, Roadmap, Tower Defense Fest, and End of Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, it's been a while! Today I want to announce Leena's second major update!

But first, to celebrate this update, Leena is 50% off in the [i][b]Tower Defense Fest[/b][/i] sale! This will be Leena's final sale in Early Access, so get it while you can at this low price!

Now to start off, yes Leena is still being worked on, and we're very close to completing the game! It'll still take a little bit longer, but we're inching closer and closer to the finished game. I'll also be discussing the final major updates and sharing a roadmap of what we have planned, as well as the estimated date we're aiming to fully release the game and exiting Early Access.

So let's get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/e1cae5fb3332da7cd2979ab3110483888965b6ec.png[/img]

[i][b]Second Major Update[/b][/i]
For this second major update, I've been hard at work on a visual rework for many reasons. The main reason however, is localization.

When I first started Leena, I had no plans to localize the game to other languages. However, as I progressed and kept working on the game, I realized it would be better to separate a lot of the menu text to its own thing for easier editing. Since it came to this, I decided to just separate ALL of the text in the game into its own system, and make it easier to just export the whole thing for easy localization if we wanted to.

This resulted in changing many things, such as text on buttons, as having text in one language may be longer in another language. Having text in a button would not work due to this. Instead I opted to switch things out for icons. I then added the icons text description to a menu at the bottom where there is more space. This temporary menu will disappear after four in-game waves during each map, as the player will know by then what each icon should represent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/021cff2919958e5a98d848e36996b05551ac7861.jpg[/img]

I also changed the fonts, as our original font had no support for any characters other than English ones. These new fonts support most languages. I also remade most menus to fit these new fonts better, as well as new menu colors, and added text effects such as shadow for menu titles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/b2c2ef741a3c7dd8727b92229d27cab62dca135d.png[/img]

Dialogue Scenes have also had a visual upgrade, as well as a new font that fits better with these new sprites and supports more languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/ed562666415013706b37dfcd8a729e9ca5828170.png[/img]

Tutorial Scenes have been improved and now display the actual menus for specific scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/4bd121ed20e8fdbc4e22ef8b5cef75f7a7a30fa5.png[/img]

Now let's get into the bigger changes in this update!

[i][b]Leena Mode[/b][/i]
In the first major update, a survival mode called [b]Endless Nightmare[/b] was added, which had 200 waves. This alpha mode was a test to see how well survival could run, and we had lots of feedback and bug reports for it, so a big thank you to the people who played!

The main issue with the alpha survival mode, is that we only had the monsters we had made in story mode at the time, so in the later levels of survival, there is a lot of repetition of the same monsters, and frankly it felt a bit incomplete. I felt that it should have been limited to 100 waves to start instead, but it remained as is since the update was already out. I decided that for the next update I wanted survival nearly or fully complete.

But, I also wanted a harder survival mode. Something completely insane, that would bring the game to its limits. And so, I announced in a Kickstarter update a few months ago I was working on a new survival mode called [i][b]Leena Mode[/b][/i]. A mode created by Leena herself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/111085f8bde317c13e17fdef35eadfbb89cdad59.png[/img]

With the visual rework, this mode came out very nice and very difficult. At a whopping 400 waves, we added [i][b]200+ new enemies[/b][/i], including new special monsters and some unique bosses you can only find in Leena mode. A new music track was made specifically for this mode as well, which I hope you'll all enjoy!

[i][b]Bonus System Expanded, and Wave Info[/b][/i]
Previously in the first update, the bonus system was exclusive to the alpha survival mode. Now, I have added the bonus system to regular maps. This means, you can earn goodies just by completing waves during the campaign.

A new tutorial scene will unlock the bonus system during the campaign, and all maps unlocked after that will have the bonus system enabled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/d71e675ba54e93d5e22161d40f027a74e8d1ae75.png[/img]

Wave information is also now available in the bonus system menu at the bottom. At a glance you can view the number of monsters in the upcoming wave, as well as an estimated number of what kinds of monsters they are, including flying types and boss types. Please be aware these are only estimates and are NOT exact number. However, this should help players prepare their defenses, and it was something several players requested both in 1 on 1 feedback and in the community forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/e0c4f83eae08617b56da75f532ee51e5a7340f17.png[/img]

[i][b]Banking System[/b][/i]
The banking system makes its debut this update. During the campaign, you'll gain the ability to deposit unused gold in the bank. This gold will gain interest every map you complete. You're able to withdraw bank funds up to a certain amount in every map the bank is enabled, provided you pay a fee to do so. The fee amount is taken from the accumulated bank funds, not from the gold you currently have on the map.

You are only able to deposit remaining gold in story maps. Survival does not qualify. You ARE able to use the bank to withdraw funds in survival modes though. Gaining a bit of extra funds on bank enabled maps will help you gain additional starting funds to build additional towers to defend! Use it wisely!

[i][b]The Tower Select Screen[/b][/i]
Before the first major update, the tower select screen already existed. When we added controller support, we had to disable the tower select screen in controller mode due to compatibility issues, but it remained available in mouse only mode.

Now, I have re-enabled the tower select screen for all modes! This makes navigating the large roster of towers much much easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/4c7d6e15ace073bcacc0d6ea813151300cc0e07e.png[/img]

Speaking of towers, this new update will add 5 new towers, and one tower previously available only in the demo, for a total of six new towers! This includes our final design tier tower [i][b]Dree[/b][/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/0660361c1447f0bc4c98a313bad8f370ae69fb1e.png[/img]

This tower brings with it the ability to give allies a shield, which gives towers an extra bar that needs to be depleted before their actual health is reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/81c3e8cb67138422ea88ab186c1284aee2e9912d.png[/img]

This update also includes our final design tier monster [i][b]Bedlam[/b][/i], which sports a very powerful shield capable of blocking all incoming projectiles. Beware!

[i][b]The Laboratory[/b][/i]
The laboratory is complete and is also included in this update. This map introduces more unique bio type monsters. These are humanoid type enemies, which are far stronger than regular monsters. These monsters can attack just like their tower counterparts, or use unique special abilities. Beware!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/16b39304364eb82923a96afb745d567005a768d4.png[/img]

[i][b]The Lair[/b][/i]
The lair is also included in this update, but only the first map. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/45eab55bf9aceb60e409c6368f6f6ee8c79bd07a.jpg[/img]

I aim to finish the Lair within the next few weeks, which will complete the campaign mode.

[i][b]Backward Compatibility[/b][/i]
Throughout development I have tried to maintain backward compatibility with game saves. So far in testing this does not seem to be a problem, but if you face any errors when loading the game (the third load screen), please report it in the steam community forums. I will make a specific forum post about any save/loading issues and how to potentially fix them or to stop them.

Backward compatibility is something that should work for saves made after the first Early Access version and beyond, but if you do have any issues, please report them to me in the forums.

[i][b]Beta Builds[/b][/i]
I have made some earlier versions of Leena available in the beta section of the application. If you'd like to play those earlier versions, you are welcome to try them. Please keep in mind however, newer saves will not work with older builds, and backward compatibility will not be guaranteed. You will have to delete/backup your save file when testing older beta builds, or to maintain backward compatibility. You can find more info in the community forums.

The last thing I'd like to discuss is the roadmap.

[i][b]Roadmap[/b][/i]
Here is a small overview of how I want this to go. Please keep in mind the dates may change slightly, but I'm hoping to stick to these dates as closely as possible.
[list]
[*] Second Major Update - Now. Includes all of the above, plus a new trailer and screenshots for the steam page.
[*] Third Major Update - Mid August
[*] Final Major Update - Late August to Early September. Will include the post-campaign worlds, and expansion of Leena mode to 500 waves (if possible). Includes final towers. Polish and bug fixes.
[*] Final Polish Update and Exit Early Access - Early to Mid September
[/list]

That's it for this update! Stay tuned for more! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/aa2c1e5fa857ea75db253f6e4bd8ba9147a37e87.png[/img]

notes.title: Updated Beta Version with Achievements and Retry Options
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just wanted to send out a quick announcement to beta players. I just released an update to Leena that adds [i][b]steam achievements[/b][/i] to the game, just in time for Early Access. For now only just a few achievements exist. Due to this update, in order to have the best play experience, I recommend deleting your save file, as previously completed levels with achievements will not unlock those achievements. 

For the players that have gained access today, I highly recommend doing this to have the best play experience if you have already started playing but wish to have all achievements.

You can find the savedata file at: C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Project_Leena

[i][b]Retry Options[/b][/i]
This update adds some quality of life additions in the form of level retries. Previously if you failed a level, you would be taken back to the map select screen and had to re-watch cutscenes. Now, if you fail a level, you will be given the option to restart the map OR to exit to map select. Upon clearing the level, it will continue to any cutscenes and send you back to map select as usual.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433900/4b37faab3c07c612fb5404a27acde9c026fed4e6.png[/img]

Should you encounter any bugs, please report them in the community hub so I can squash them.

Currently the last playable level is Nightmare Realm - Ghost Trap (World 7, level 1). Completing this level will not unlock further levels nor clear for the moment. I expect to update once more before Early Access in a few days, and then continue to update at a steady pace following the release. Stay tuned!
